records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 Form 10-Q — collateral asset hierarchy and encumbrance reconciliation
records.note: Reconciles balance-sheet and Note 6/Note 12 presentations. USD1.299500B crypto assets held as collateral on balance sheet = USD997.557M recognized lending crypto collateral + USD301.943M recognized derivatives collateral. Recognized lending collateral total is USD1.009297B after adding USD11.740M fiat/payment stablecoins. Customer collateral not recognized is USD3.284562B. Company-owned assets pledged against short-term borrowings are USD434.163M and are a separate encumbrance view. Crypto assets borrowed are USD389.657M; loan receivables USD1.976137B. Obligation to return collateral is a separate liability. No XRP-specific amount disclosed.
